lead: Andimuthu Raja is an Indian politician, born on 10 May 1963 in Andimadam.
As of 2026, he is 63 years old, and his birth date places him under the Taurus sign.
He has held the office of Member of the 13th Lok Sabha and Member of the 15th Lok Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Andimuthu Raja: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Andimuthu Raja — Early Life, Family and Education

sections.heading: Andimuthu Raja — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician and lawyer as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 13th Lok Sabha (1999–2004), Member of the 15th Lok Sabha (2009–2014), Member of the 17th Lok Sabha (2019–present), Member of the 11th Lok Sabha (1996–1997) and Member of the 14th Lok Sabha (2004–2009). He is affiliated with Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam.
